# Rishikesh Homestays

> Rishikesh Homestays helps travellers find and book traveller-friendly homestays in Rishikesh, India, near Tapovan, Triveni Ghat, Swarg Ashram, Muni Ki Reti, and Neelkanth Road. The site lists sample homestays by area, type, and budget, and lets visitors send a booking inquiry by form or WhatsApp.

Rishikesh Homestays is not a single property — it is a curated shortlist service. Visitors describe their trip (dates, group size, area preference, budget, pets) and the team responds with matching homestay options within about 24 hours.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/): overview, featured homestays, quick search by area/traveller type/date.
- [Homestays](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/homestays): full list of sample homestays, filterable by area, budget, and traveller type.
- [Advaitam Ganga & Hill View Luxury 3BHK](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/hotels/advaitam-ganga-hill-view-luxury-3bhk-homestay-in-rishikesh): private 3-bedroom, 7-bed, 3-bathroom family and group homestay in Nirmal Bagh, Rishikesh for up to 10 guests, around 50m from a Ganga ghat and evening aarti. Includes Ganga and hill views, kitchen, Wi-Fi, living room, Zomato/Swiggy/Blinkit access, 15% off 10+ night stays, Airbnb photo gallery, and direct WhatsApp/contact booking support.
- [Plan my stay / Contact](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/contact): booking inquiry form (name, phone, dates, guests, pets, area, budget) and direct phone/WhatsApp/email contact details.
- [Things to Do](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/things-to-do-in-rishikesh): yoga, rafting, Ganga Aarti, cafes, waterfalls, temples, and river walks in Rishikesh.
- [About Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/about-rishikesh): guide to Rishikesh's areas, culture, and travel pace for people deciding where to stay.
- [Places to Visit / Restaurants & Cafes](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/places-to-visit): two tabs on one page — must-see local sights (Triveni Ghat, Parmarth Niketan, Beatles Ashram, Neer Garh Waterfall, Neelkanth Mahadev Temple, and more), and where to eat (riverside cafes, German bakeries, Israeli food, organic cafes, local thali spots, and why every menu is vegetarian and alcohol-free). The restaurants tab is at `/places-to-visit#restaurants`.
- [Triveni Ghat](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/triveni-ghat): dedicated guide to the evening Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat and how to visit respectfully.
- [Kedarnath & Garhwal](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/kedarnath-yatra): routes, distances, best season, and sample itineraries for Kedarnath, Badrinath, Gangotri, Yamunotri, and Auli from Rishikesh.
- [Haridwar Kumbh Mela 2027](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/haridwar-kumbh-2027): reported bathing dates, tithi, Kumbh significance, Amrit Snan planning, long weekends, and why Rishikesh is a good nearby base.
- [List Your Homestay](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/list-your-homestay): for property owners in Rishikesh who want to list their homestay/guest house with us — application form, no listing fee.

## Where to stay: compare every listed stay in Rishikesh

Comparison pages for every kind of stay in Rishikesh. Each shows counts by area, typical price ranges, pet-friendly and Ganga-facing shares, FAQs, and our own book-direct homestays first.
<!-- stays-pages:start -->
- [Best Hotels in Rishikesh (all stays)](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-hotels-in-rishikesh): 1,608 stays of every type, grouped by category. Every hotel, homestay, resort, camp, hostel and villa we found listed in Rishikesh, from simple rooms to 5-star stays, grouped by category.
- [Best Homestays in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-homestays-in-rishikesh): 130 homestays. Family-run homes where you stay with locals, often with home-cooked food and a quieter street.
- [Best Resorts in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-resorts-in-rishikesh): 156 resorts. Resorts with gardens, pools and river or hill views, mostly along the Neelkanth and Badrinath roads.
- [Best Camps in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-camps-in-rishikesh): 19 camps. Riverside and jungle camps and glamping tents, mostly along the Shivpuri rafting stretch.
- [Best Hostels in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-hostels-in-rishikesh): 143 hostels. Backpacker hostels with dorms and private rooms, most of them in Tapovan and around Laxman Jhula.
- [Best Villas in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-villas-in-rishikesh): 45 villas. Private villas for groups and families, many with a garden, terrace or pool.
- [Best Apartments in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-apartments-in-rishikesh): 305 apartments. Serviced 1BHK to 4BHK apartments with kitchens, good for long stays and families.
- [Best Guest Houses in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-guest-houses-in-rishikesh): 86 guest houses. Small guest houses with simple rooms, usually close to the ghats and markets.
- [Best Cottages in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-cottages-in-rishikesh): 45 cottages. Cottages in the hills and gardens around Rishikesh, away from the town crowds.
- [Best Bed & Breakfasts in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-bed-and-breakfasts-in-rishikesh): 35 bed & breakfasts. Bed & breakfasts where the morning meal comes with the room.
- [Best Holiday Rentals in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-holiday-rentals-in-rishikesh): 14 holiday rentals. Whole homes and flats to rent for a holiday, booked as one unit.
- [Best Ashram Stays in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-ashram-stays-in-rishikesh): 14 ashram stays. Ashrams that take guests, with simple rooms and daily yoga, satsang or aarti.
- [Best Aparthotels in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-aparthotels-in-rishikesh): 16 aparthotels. Hotel-run apartments: a kitchen and living space with hotel housekeeping and a front desk.
- [Best Lodges in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-lodges-in-rishikesh): 7 lodges. Simple lodges with basic rooms, usually close to the main roads and markets.
- [Best Pet-Friendly Stays in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-pet-friendly-stays-in-rishikesh): 445 pet-friendly stays. Stays that list pets as allowed, so you can bring your dog to Rishikesh.
- [Best Ganga View Stays in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-ganga-view-stays-in-rishikesh): 247 ganga view stays. Stays on or facing the Ganga: river views, private ghats and riverside rooms.
- [Best Luxury Stays in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-luxury-stays-in-rishikesh): 321 luxury stays. 4 and 5-star properties and premium stays from ₹8,000 a night.
- [Best Budget Stays in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-budget-stays-in-rishikesh): 187 budget stays. Rooms and beds from ₹1,500 a night or less.
- [Best Yoga Stays in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-yoga-stays-in-rishikesh): 226 yoga stays. Stays with yoga classes on site, from ashram-style retreats to hotels with a daily session.
- [Best Spa & Wellness Stays in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-spa-and-wellness-stays-in-rishikesh): 195 spa & wellness stays. Stays with a spa, wellness centre or massage, including Ayurveda-focused retreats.
- [Best Family-Friendly Stays in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-family-friendly-stays-in-rishikesh): 58 family-friendly stays. Stays that welcome families, with family rooms and space for children.
- [Best Long Stays with a Kitchen in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-long-stays-with-kitchen-in-rishikesh): 264 long stays with a kitchen. Stays with a private or shared kitchen, good for weeks-long yoga courses and workations.
- [Best Stays with Airport Pickup in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-stays-with-airport-pickup-in-rishikesh): 327 stays with airport pickup. Stays that arrange a transfer from Dehradun's Jolly Grant airport, about 35 km from Rishikesh.
- [Best Business Hotels in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-business-hotels-in-rishikesh): 124 business hotels. Hotels with a business centre or meeting and banquet halls, for work trips, retreats and events.
- [Best Boutique Hotels in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-boutique-hotels-in-rishikesh): 14 boutique hotels. Small, design-led hotels with a distinct character.
- [Best Stays with a Jacuzzi in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-stays-with-jacuzzi-in-rishikesh): 25 stays with a jacuzzi. Stays that list a jacuzzi among their facilities, often in suites and villas.
- [Best Stays with a Pool in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/best-stays-with-pool-in-rishikesh): 137 stays with a pool. Properties that list a swimming pool among their facilities.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- Prices, availability, and the specific homestays listed change over time — always point users to the live [Homestays page](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/homestays) or the [Contact page](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/contact) rather than quoting a fixed price from a cached copy of this site.
- The fastest way for a real traveller to get a response is the [Contact form](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/contact) or WhatsApp — both go to the same inbox and are answered by a human, not an automated booking engine.
- The [Haridwar Kumbh Mela 2027 page](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/haridwar-kumbh-2027) lists dates reported by third-party tour operators, explicitly flagged on that page as not officially confirmed. Do not state them as certain — point users to the page itself, which explains the uncertainty.
